text:
Type: solid pine dining chair
Use: dining, sitting at a table; kitchen, dining room, cabin
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, farmhouse
Materials: untreated solid pine with visible knots and grain
Colors: pale natural pine, light warm yellow wood
Shape: tall back with two broad horizontal rails, flat solid seat, square straight legs with low side stretchers, simple sturdy frame, medium visual weight
Feel: natural, honest, warm, simple
Goes with: pine or oak tables, white walls, cotton textiles; cabins, rustic kitchens, Scandinavian country rooms

product.name: IVAR
product.description: Solid wood is a hardwearing natural material which can be sanded and surface treated when required.
